summary: Iteration 19: Validated (1) PDF Payment Report download and (2) Post Sales Collections widget. All 6 pytest cases pass (4 PDF role checks + 2 collections payload checks). Playwright verified UI end-to-end: collections widget renders with all 7 filter chips, 'Awaiting Verification' filter correctly narrows to Plot 32 Instalment 1 (Rs 2,00,000 awaiting, verification=Awaiting, status=Overdue), and action link routes to /sales. PlotDrilldown modal 'Download Payment Report' button triggered a genuine PDF download (%PDF magic bytes, ~108KB, filename Payment_Report_32.pdf) for post_sales, admin, AND accounts roles with zero error toasts. Regression: modal shows Booking (Verified), Instalment 1 (Pending w/ Awaiting verification + YES/NO buttons visible for verifiers), and Instalment 2 (Pending) — the maker-checker pipeline is intact. Demo booking cleanup performed as requested (Admin cancel + Mongo delete of 1 cancellation + 8 notifications; unit_8077ee366ecf is now status=available, 0 payments).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /units/{unit_id}/payment-report correctly gates via require_section(sales,admin,accounts,post_sales) and returns Response(media_type=application/pdf) with Content-Disposition attachment. Content builds via reportlab _build_report_pdf.

PostSalesDashboard collections widget uses clean derivation (verified/awaiting/returned) matched against maker-checker semantics; only verified amounts contribute to `received`, pending amounts flow into `awaiting` — consistent with backend dashboard payload.
Login response uses `access_token` key (not `token`); prior test template implied `token` — call this out for future test harness reuse.
cancel endpoint requires `cancel_date` + optional `amount_refunded`; not obvious from route signature — consider adding an example in OpenAPI docs.

success_rate.frontend: 3/3 role downloads + widget render + filter + action link (100%)

seed_data_creation: None. Used the pre-seeded demo booking (CVF Plot 32 / Ravi Kumar). Per main agent's instruction, cancelled that booking + deleted cancellation & 8 notifications at end of run; unit_8077ee366ecf is now available with 0 payments. Main agent must re-seed the demo booking if further iterations depend on it.
